nodes.label: Expo SDK 56 Documentation Requirement
nodes.rationale: Read exact versioned Expo SDK 56 docs before writing code.

nodes.label: Client State Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Server cache, UI state, preferences, and secrets have distinct owners.

nodes.label: Expo Testing Strategy
nodes.rationale: Use configured static and manual checks until test setup is explicitly requested.

nodes.label: Expo Design System
nodes.rationale: Tokens and reusable component contracts provide one visual source of truth.

nodes.label: Prefer useDerivedValue
nodes.rationale: Derived values declaratively track dependencies; reactions are intended for side effects.

nodes.label: GestureDetector Press States
nodes.rationale: UI-thread gesture worklets avoid a JavaScript-thread round trip for animated press feedback.

nodes.label: GPU Animation Properties
nodes.rationale: Transform and opacity animation avoids per-frame layout recalculation.

nodes.label: Compound Components
nodes.rationale: Dedicated child components make roles explicit and improve composition.

nodes.label: Native Font Embedding
nodes.rationale: The expo-font config plugin makes fonts available at launch without asynchronous loading state.

nodes.label: Design System Import Boundary
nodes.rationale: A design-system re-export boundary enables global implementation changes without app-wide import rewrites.

nodes.label: Hoisted Intl Formatters
nodes.rationale: Intl formatter construction is expensive, so static instances should be created once at module scope.

nodes.label: Stable List Callbacks
nodes.rationale: A stable callback shared by list items reduces allocations and avoidable re-renders.

nodes.label: Stable Object References for Virtualized Lists
nodes.rationale: Virtualization relies on stable item references to avoid rerendering unchanged visible items.

nodes.label: Compressed List Images
nodes.rationale: Appropriately sized thumbnails reduce memory use and scroll jank.

nodes.label: Stable renderItem Props
nodes.rationale: Primitive or hoisted props preserve memoization by avoiding new references.

nodes.label: Lightweight List Items
nodes.rationale: Moving queries and expensive work out of list items reduces scrolling cost.

nodes.label: Primitive List Item Props
nodes.rationale: Primitive props enable predictable shallow memo comparison.

nodes.label: Heterogeneous List Item Types
nodes.rationale: Explicit item types create efficient recycling pools and avoid layout thrashing.

nodes.label: List Virtualization
nodes.rationale: Rendering only visible items reduces memory and mount time.

nodes.label: Native Dependency Autolinking
nodes.rationale: Native dependencies must be installed in the app package because autolinking scans its node_modules.

nodes.label: Single Monorepo Dependency Versions
nodes.rationale: Exact unified versions avoid duplicate bundles and runtime conflicts.

nodes.label: Native Navigation
nodes.rationale: Native stacks, tabs, and headers provide platform behavior and UI-thread performance.

nodes.label: React Compiler Shared Value Accessors
nodes.rationale: Reanimated get and set methods remain trackable by React Compiler.

nodes.label: State Dispatch Updaters
nodes.rationale: Functional updaters avoid stale closures and can skip unchanged object-state renders.

nodes.label: Minimal Derived State
nodes.rationale: Deriving computable values prevents redundant state and drift.

nodes.label: Safe Conditional Rendering
nodes.rationale: Falsy renderable values leaked by logical AND can crash React Native outside Text.

nodes.label: Ground-Truth State
nodes.rationale: State should represent underlying conditions while visual outputs are derived.

nodes.label: Native Platform Menus
nodes.rationale: Native menus provide accessibility, platform-consistent interaction, and better performance than custom JavaScript menus.

nodes.label: Native Form Sheets
nodes.rationale: Native sheets provide gestures, keyboard handling, accessibility, and native performance.

nodes.label: Native Safe Area Scroll Adjustment
nodes.rationale: Automatic content inset adjustment handles dynamic safe areas without manual padding or layout shifts.

nodes.label: Dynamic Scroll Content Insets
nodes.rationale: contentInset changes scroll bounds without forcing content layout recalculation.

nodes.label: Child Device Pairing Codes
nodes.rationale: Short-lived one-time codes authenticate an existing child profile without creating duplicate children or exposing a permanent password.

nodes.label: Wallet Reward Reservation Invariant
nodes.rationale: Reward edits, approval, rejection, and deletion must preserve balances and reserves atomically.

nodes.label: Circular Icon Safe Zones
nodes.rationale: Two concentric circles visually define nested placement and crop-safe regions for centered Android icon artwork.

nodes.label: Center Alignment Guides
nodes.rationale: Vertical, horizontal, triangular, and center-point guides establish the visual center and symmetry axes for foreground artwork.

nodes.label: Blue Chevron Brand Mark
nodes.rationale: A thick blue upward chevron is the dominant identifying symbol and remains legible at favicon scale.

nodes.label: Rounded Square Icon Tile
nodes.rationale: The pale rounded-square field provides contrast, padding, and a compact application-icon silhouette around the central mark.

nodes.label: Centered Proportion Guides
nodes.rationale: A square grid and three concentric circles provide center, scale, and proportion guides for splash artwork placement.
